messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

Wide RF modulation bandwidth is important because A&D applications require generation of complex pulsed signals, and the cited vector signal generator provides up to 1 GHz RF modulation bandwidth [26].
Broad RF frequency coverage is important because the cited generator covers 8 kHz to 6 GHz and all important RF bands for digital wireless communications [26].
High output power and excellent signal quality are important because the cited generator is described as combining high output power, wide modulation bandwidth, and excellent signal quality [26].
4G/5G-capable signal generation is important because the same bandwidth is stated to satisfy challenging fourth- and fifth-generation communications requirements [26].
Contested-spectrum and anti-jamming test capability is important because defense private 5G drivers include smart jamming, improved electronic-warfare tactics, complex RF environments, and contested spectrum [8].
Tactical 5G and Future-G waveform support is important because the roadmap includes widespread 5G tactical networks, hybrid commercial/military networks, 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios, ISAC, URLLC, and AI-native battlefield connectivity [2].
Low-latency communications test capability is important because autonomous systems and drones are listed as requiring low latency [8].
Satellite/NTN signal-generation realism is important because NTN testing must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences [20].
Reproducible and accurate scenario generation is important because NTN test conditions need to be reproducible, accurate, and comparable [20].
Waveform playback capability depends on supported frequency range, maximum signal bandwidth, ARB memory size, and maximum sample clock rate [27].
EMC/EME-oriented signal generation is relevant because military and aviation drone testing references MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 for EMI, electromagnetic environmental effects, and airborne equipment environmental test procedures [21].
【推論】The most important A&D signal-generation capabilities are wideband pulsed RF generation, tactical 5G/6G and anti-jamming scenario generation, realistic NTN/satellite impairment generation, robust waveform playback resources, and EMC/EME stimulus support, based on the cited A&D, defense-5G, NTN, waveform-playback, and drone-EMC requirements [26][8][2][20][27][21].
